title: Guides bundle generation record
description: guides.lock.json at the bundle root, contract version 0.3. See section 5.3 of guides-contract.md. Records what the generator last wrote and which of its pages a person deleted. Members not defined here are allowed and are ignored by the portal. Rules this schema does not express: each slug appears once in pages and once in deleted, and never in both (invalid-lock); no object has a duplicate key (invalid-lock); both lists are sorted by slug, by Unicode code point; the file is at most 2 MB (size-limit) and nested at most 64 deep. A slug is a lookup key and is never joined into a path. settingsSha256 is the generator's own note: the portal does not decide from it whether to run.

pages.description: One entry per page the generator wrote and still tracks.

sha256.description: SHA-256, lowercase hex, of the page file's bytes exactly as the generator wrote them.

deleted.description: Slugs of pages the generator wrote and a person then deleted. The generator does not write them again.

navSha256.description: A hash the generator defines over nav as it last wrote it. The portal does not interpret it.

settingsSha256.description: SHA-256, lowercase hex, of the bytes of the settings.json the run used. Absent when the run had no settings.
